def _entry_namespace(entry: VulnerabilityProfileEntryInput) -> NamespaceScope:
    """Scope to hand the guard for NV_ALLOWED_NAMESPACES.

    An entry with no namespaces suppresses the CVE everywhere, which is broader
    than any allowlist entry could authorise, so it reports as CLUSTER_WIDE. An
    entry pinned to several namespaces reports all of them: gating only the
    single-namespace case would mean naming *more* namespaces bought *less*
    enforcement.
    """
    return tuple(entry.namespaces) if entry.namespaces else CLUSTER_WIDE


def _entries_namespace(entries: Sequence[VulnerabilityProfileEntryInput]) -> NamespaceScope:
    """Combined scope of a whole-profile replace.

    The replace drops any entry it does not restate, so its reach is the union of
    the entries it carries — and cluster-wide the moment any one of them is.
    """
    if any(not entry.namespaces for entry in entries):
        return CLUSTER_WIDE
    return tuple(sorted({ns for entry in entries for ns in entry.namespaces}))
